title: When THE DREAMER meets THE CONTROLLER:

dialogue.speaker: THE DREAMER
dialogue.text: I predict the next frame will shift to the left. I predict the car will slide. I predict the sky will be blue.

dialogue.speaker: THE CONTROLLER
dialogue.text: I will steer left. I will accelerate.

dialogue.speaker: THE DREAMER
dialogue.text: Okay. You steered left. Now the track looks like this.

dialogue.speaker: THE TRACK
dialogue.text: They play this game for a million cycles. The Controller learns to drive perfectly, but it has never seen a real track. It has only driven in the dream.

dialogue.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
dialogue.text: We do not see the world; we see our model of the world. The baseball player does not calculate physics; he swings at his prediction. He acts on the hallucination.

dialogue.speaker: THE CONTROLLER
dialogue.text: The physics are wrong! The monsters are cheating!

dialogue.speaker: THE DREAMER
dialogue.text: If you can survive my nightmare, you can survive reality.

dialogue.speaker: THE REAL
dialogue.text: The car speeds around the track, breaking records. The agent dodges fireballs, surviving longer than any human.

dialogue.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
dialogue.text: We can train agents inside their own dreams. We can learn from the hallucination. Reality is just a special case of the model.
